jobs.title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - Germany)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products
 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 
 One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 
 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 
 
 At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.
 Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .
 And we’re only just getting started! 
 
 Our Team
 We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.
 
 Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]
 • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 
 • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 
 • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 
 
 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]
 • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 
 
 Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]
 • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 
 
 Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]
 • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 
 • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 
 • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 
 • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 
 
 Your Role
 We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.
 You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.
 This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.
 Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.
 Here’s what you can expect:
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

 Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

 Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

 Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

 Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

 Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

 Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

 
 Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - POS Hardware (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 

 

 Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow. 

 

 At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 700 experts of 55 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience. 

 

 Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference. 

 

 Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin. 

 

 ABOUT THE TEAM 

 Unzer's POS department is the commercial engine connecting Unzer's terminal technology to merchants across Europe — spanning Field & Inside Sales, Merchant Services, Onboarding, Technical Support, and Sales Strategy. As Product Manager for traditional POS, you'll own the commercial and operational product experience around our point-of-sale payment terminal business. You'll work at the intersection of external vendors, Sales, Key Account Management, Onboarding, and Strategy to turn field insights into product and process improvements that make a real difference to merchants, vendors, and to the teams who support them. 

 What your work will look like: 
 

 Own the Product Roadmap & its Delivery: 
Build and execute the product roadmap for one or more product areas, ensuring on-time delivery of features and improvements that support business objectives. 

 Business Impact & Prioritization Ownership: 
Co-own prioritization and business impact of product initiatives, focusing on revenue growth and cost efficiency. 

 KPI Definition & Performance Tracking: 
Define and track KPIs across multiple product areas to measure product success and drive continuous improvement in alignment with Unzer’s strategic goals. 

 Drive Cross-functional Initiatives: 
Lead cross-team collaboration by influencing critical operational decisions, managing resources, and facilitating effective execution of major product initiatives. 

 Facilitate collaboration: 
Build effective relationships with internal colleagues and external partners to gather requirements, communicate priorities, and ensure successful project outcomes. 

 Resource Allocation and Performance Management: 
Oversee allocation and effective use of resources within your domain, monitoring project progress, mitigating risks, and driving performance to meet technical and group objectives. 

 What you need to be successful in this role: 
 

 5+ years product management experience in Tech, ideally in Payments Hardware - a plus if gained within a financially regulated company. 

 You have robust experience planning and executing product initiatives while establishing milestones to ensure on-time, on-budget, and high-quality delivery. 

 You are data driven and solving complex problems by identifying the best path to deliver value faster comes naturally to you. 

 You facilitate cross-functional collaboration between teams and build strong relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders. 

 You communicate with impact, clearly conveying complex ideas to varied audiences, leading discussions, building consensus, and influencing key decisions. 

 You bring creativity and a continuous improvement mindset, delivering innovative solutions and leading product or process enhancements. 

 You demonstrate leadership and adaptability by guiding teams through change, embracing new technologies and AI practices, and maintaining high professional standards. 

 Fluent in German and English

 Please note that we will not sponsor your visa or relocation, and you must have a valid work permit to be eligible for this position. 

 What’s next? 
 

 Does it sound exciting? - Apply with your CV in English. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you. 

 The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 60-min Hiring Manager interview, a 45-min skills assessment call with a stakeholder and a final executive interview, 30 min. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability. 

 
 
 
 WHAT WE OFFER 

 
 More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍 

 
 At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team. 

 
 We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career. 

 
 🏡 Flexibility that works

jobs.title: Head of Product - Subscriptions
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

You are an experienced Product Leader—strategic, analytical, and customer-focused with strong problem solving skills and a commercial mindset.

You will own Membership Plans and the wider Subscriptions platform across multiple markets, shaping how we structure, price, and deliver value to our members as Tide scales. This role is central to defining the future of our subscription offering, ensuring it is flexible, competitive, and aligned to member needs.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will optimise the end-to-end subscription experience. This includes defining and refining membership tiers, benefits, and pricing models, while ensuring seamless lifecycle management—from sign-up and upgrades through to renewals, downgrades, and cancellations.

You will join the Member Engagement Marketing (MEM) product group, responsible for driving engagement, retention, and long-term member value. Membership Plans sit at the heart of this mission, ensuring members clearly understand and experience the value of their Tide membership. You will collaborate closely with Billing, Payments, Marketing, Data, Finance, Engineering, and Design to deliver a frictionless, transparent, and engaging subscription journey.

As Head of Product for Membership Plans, you will:

  • Own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for our global Membership Plans, delivering a high-quality, scalable member experience.
  • Define, evolve, and optimise subscription tiers, benefits, and pricing, using customer insight and data to drive impact.
  • Lead end-to-end product delivery, from discovery through execution, across the full subscription lifecycle.
  • Partner cross-functionally to deliver measurable business outcomes, aligned to company OKRs and growth priorities.
  • Champion best-in-class user experience, ensuring clarity, transparency, and consistency across all membership touchpoints.
  • Mentor and support Product Managers as the team scales.
  • Leverage qualitative and quantitative insights to improve retention and long-term member value.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with proven ownership of subscription, membership, or product-led growth initiatives.
  • Strong analytical and commercial capability, with experience defining KPIs/OKRs and driving revenue- and retention-focused outcomes.
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across technical and commercial teams.
  • A customer-first, outcome-driven mindset, focused on delivering meaningful, high-impact member experiences.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments, translating complexity into clear priorities and execution plans.
  • Clear, confident communicator, able to articulate product vision and trade-offs to diverse audiences.
  • Experience building scalable, global products, with awareness of local market and regulatory considerations.

jobs.title: Senior Software Product Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril Australia's Dive-XL Platform team is building the software and systems that define how an extra-large autonomous undersea vehicle operates, navigates, and executes missions. The Platform pillar is responsible for the full vehicle stack, from embedded vehicle management and safe navigation through to the mission software layer that determines what the vehicle does, how it communicates, and how operators interact with it.

This role sits at the centre of how Dive-XL's software capabilities are shaped and delivered. You will work closely with stakeholders across Dive-XL Platform engineering, Maritime Enabling Technology, Maritime Application Development, and Program teams to drive product design, particularly around the software features delivered on the mission software layer. A key objective is championing operator experience for Dive-XL, translating operational needs into well-defined software requirements, and ensuring what gets built delivers real capability to the people who use these systems. If you want to own the "what" and the "why" for software on a platform that is actively deployed and scaling, this is the role.

About the Job

Software Product Managers develop a detailed understanding of user, customer, and business needs, define what to build, why to build it, then independently lead projects to integrate those software capabilities with our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control or decision support. We expect Software Product Managers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership of one or more significant projects or products, driving work through our engineering governance process, co-ordinating and directly contributing to project execution, and managing adoption of the solution by internal and external customers. Our Software Product Managers will also provide tactical subject matter expertise to cross-functional engineering teams as required.

  • Empathize with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment

  • Manage a 6 - 18 month roadmap for your allocated projects
  • Define, document, gain consensus for, and communicate appropriate goals and plans for your projects, derived from broader organizational vision, strategy, and priorities
  • Co-ordinate your project(s) roadmap and execution with other teams across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines
  • Be responsible for co-ordinating and directly contributing to execution on one or more Software Engineering projects from definition through to delivery, optimizing for the delivery of value to the end-user
  • Drive work through Anduril’s engineering governance process, working with your teams to present plans and designs to internal stakeholders
  • Manage programmatic risk for your projects, and collaborate with engineers to manage technical risk, including sound and timely decision making

Who We Are:

NaturalMotion is an award-winning UK game studio dedicated to crafting world-class mobile experiences. Alongside our continued live-service development on CSR Racing 2 (#1 drag racing series of all time), our team is stepping into its next chapter with an ambitious, unannounced project. Honoured for eight consecutive years as a GamesIndustry.biz Best Place to Work in the UK winner and named a Top 50 UK Game Maker in 2025 and 2026, we offer a collaborative studio culture backed by the global reach of Zynga and Take-Two Interactive.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us at NaturalMotion to help build a new, unannounced mobile free-to-play action game.

We embrace a hybrid work environment. Within this role, you would work 2 days per week in our London office and the remaining days at home.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work closely with a multi-disciplined team (Design, Art, Programming & Analytics) to design, scope and implement core features that result in an outstanding gameplay experience for our players and positively inflect metrics.
  • Own and manage the live operations schedule, ensuring best-in-class execution. Emphasis on attention to detail, proactive communication, and measurable results.
  • Support the leadership team in defining and iterating upon the game’s business strategy to build a robust product roadmap for development and post-launch live content.

  • Collaborate effectively across different business divisions, including release operations, user acquisition, legal, and other stakeholders, given the use of an established Take-Two IP.
  • Effectively champion product vision & strategy, monitor product progression through completion of milestones and partner with other parts of the organisation including Central Analytics and Product Marketing.
  • Build knowledge and understanding of data driven insights within the rest of the team through regular communication about relevant dashboards and reports.
  • Act as an independent, self-starter capable of driving projects forward autonomously.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Product Management experience in free-to-play game development, with a proven track record in managing live operations and executing best-in-class practices.
  • Strong passion for and in-depth knowledge of mid-core games, specifically within the action, shooter, or RPG genres.
  • Proven experience working effectively with various cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., release operations, user acquisition, legal).

  • Ability to create wire-frames, product specifications and white papers.
  • Exceptional data analysis skills, coupled with advanced Excel and SQL proficiency.

  • Strong organisational and analytical skills, as well as excellent attention to detail.

  • Previous experience with new game development through to worldwide launch.
  • Experience with shipping/managing games on multiple platforms.

  • 26 days holiday, plus bank holidays & 2 paid personal days

  • Fitness reimbursement plan, worth £600 per annum

jobs.title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - UK)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products
 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 
 One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 
 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 
 
 At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.
 Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .
 And we’re only just getting started! 
 
 Our Team
 We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.
 
 Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]
 • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 
 • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 
 • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 
 
 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]
 • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 
 
 Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]
 • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 
 • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 
 
 Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]
 • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 
 • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 
 • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 
 • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 
 
 Your Role
 We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.
 You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.
 This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.
 Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.
 Here’s what you can expect:
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

 Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

 Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

 Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

 Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

 Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

 Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

 
 Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub .
 
 Your Qualifications
 Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards:

 Your Role
 We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.
 You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.
 This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.
 Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.
 Here’s what you can expect:
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

 Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

 Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

 Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

 Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

 Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

 Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

 
 Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub .

jobs.description:
At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Platform stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. 

 
 We’re looking for a product manager to own our kits and workflows, including EV Profiler and LNP Profiler, now that the concept is proven. You’ll make sure sample preparation, fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software work together as one system, and your responsibility is the complete customer experience, from sample to scientifically meaningful result. The job is making that system rock solid: hardening what’s already on the market, making sure it works the same way at every site, and getting more customers on it without support load growing at the same rate.

 As part of the Product team, you’ll own the product management of our kits and end-to-end workflows, including the Discovery Kit, EV Profiler and LNP Profiler and their future revisions. You will ensure these work together with automated sample preparation and fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software to deliver reliable, reproducible and intuitive solutions for our customers. 

 
 The initial products have launched, and the work now is making them dependable, repeatable, and scalable for our customers. As a product manager, you’ll be the connective tissue between software, hardware, bioware, support, and the field, acting as the voice of the customer to help internal teams better understand our customers’ needs and problems. 

 
 The role is ideal for a technically curious, commercially aware individual who loves getting hands-on with products, takes ownership of outcomes and thrives on complex, cross-functional challenges. You will work broadly across our platform and alongside US colleagues; the position is based in Oxford and involves occasional travel to customers and our US team (typically 10-20%).

 The role 

 We are looking for a Director Product Manager to advance our identity resolution capabilities and build future-proof identity and activation solutions. You will own product strategy and roadmap across both identity and activation, bring a clear point of view on where the market is heading, and turn that into products customers want to buy. 

 This is a senior role for someone who can operate at two altitudes. You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. You will play a meaningful part in expanding our client base, which means you understand the market, the buyers, and what it takes to win them. 

 What You'll Do: 
 
 
 
 Own the product vision and roadmap for identity resolution and activation, and make the prioritization calls that keep the team focused on what matters most. 

 
 Advance our identity resolution product: graph building and enrichment, cross-device and cross-identifier linking, and interoperability. 

 
 Own the activation side with equal weight: audience activation, data orchestration, and delivery across a broad and growing set of destinations, including platforms and DSPs, in cloud-native environments.

 Partner directly with customers and commercial teams to understand what they need, and translate commercial requirements into clear, buildable specifications for engineering.

 Significant product management experience in AdTech, MarTech, or B2B data platforms, with a track record of owning products end to end. 

 
 Deep domain expertise in identity resolution and device/identity graphs: how graphs are built, enriched, maintained, and measured. 

 
 Strong experience in the activation and data movement domain: audience activation, destination integrations, and cloud-native or composable data architectures.

 Comfort setting direction and operating with ambiguity in an early-stage environment. 

 
 Working knowledge of the privacy and consent landscape and how it shapes data products. 

 
 Curiosity about how AI is changing product configuration, data discovery, and activation workflows. 

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Search & Ranking
jobs.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission

Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience.

In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love.

This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact.

The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works.

You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams.

What you will do

  1. Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking.
  2. Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion.
  3. Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities.
  4. Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans.
  5. Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling.
  6. Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation.
  7. Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes.
  8. Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey.
  9. Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy.
  10. Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions.
  11. Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning.
  12. Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ.
  13. Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders.

Who you are

Three qualities matter most in this role.

Outcome ownership

You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

Systems thinking

You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey.

Experimental rigour

You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity.

You will also bring:

  1. At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale.
  2. Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features.
  3. Experience defining product strategy or roadmaps for search, ranking, recommendations, personalisatio

jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role 
 We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative’s user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
 You’ll drive growth and adoption across the self-serve product experience, focusing on how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There’s no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you’ll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.
 
 What you’ll do 
 Drive growth and adoption of the self-serve product, focusing on onboarding, activation, and upgrade moments, and partnering with growth, lifecycle, and pricing teams where they connect

 Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

 Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

 Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

 Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

 Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

 Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

 Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

 
 Requirements 
 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

 A track record of moving growth and adoption metrics through the products you’ve shipped

 Evaluations. Own the product-facing eval taxonomy, eval strategy, and eval runs.

 Applied post-training. Set the priorities for the squad's Applied Researchers, who finetune and run RL to improve our core models and to build variants for specific customers and products. You decide what's worth building, define what success looks like, and check that results hold up with no regressions.

 Data. Define the data we need to measure and improve our models.

 Model releases. Co-lead new model releases. You own the quality go/no-go and the capability claims.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 PM experience (product or research) working directly on generative models. You've shaped the model itself rather than building features on top of it.

 Real technical depth. You can read an eval design and spot what's wrong with it, and you understand finetuning and RL well enough to scope and challenge the work. Researchers take you seriously because of what you know.

 Owned evaluation for a model release, including the ship call or the capability claims.

 Scoped and shipped a finetuned model or variant for a specific customer or product need.

 Diagnosed a quality regression or plateau and traced it to a data, training, or eval-design cause.

 Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

 Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

 Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

 If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Die Rolle ist stark operativ geprägt und kombiniert Support, Projektarbeit und Systemverantwortung.

 Übernahme der End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Microsoft Dynamics 365 FSCM & Business Central Landschaft

 Zentrale technische und funktionale Ansprechperson für globale Dynamics-365-Themen

 Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von ERP-Rollouts und Weiterentwicklungsprojekten

 Sicherstellung des 1st-, 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Supports für ERP-Anwendungen

 Beratung und Unterstützung der Endanwender im Tagesgeschäft

 Leitung und Koordination von ERP-IT-Projekten und Teilprojekten

 Steuerung externer IT-Partner, Lieferanten und Implementierungsteams

 Weiterentwicklung von ERP-Prozessen sowie Optimierung der Systemlandschaft

 Aufbau, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung von ERP Application Specialists

 Förderung von Wissensaustausch, Dokumentation und Best Practices

 Unterstützung bei Ressourcen- und Kapazitätsplanung im ERP-Umfeld

 
 
 Ihr Profil: 
 Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich ERP Application Management oder ERP Consulting

 Sehr gute praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 FSCM und/oder Business Central

 Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von ERP-Projekten in internationalen Umgebungen

 Gutes Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen, idealerweise im Industrie- oder Produktionsumfeld

 Ausgeprägte Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Als Senior Projectmanager (Program Manager) binnen het People & Process Office van CloudNation ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van complexe cloud- en AI-programma’s. Je zorgt voor voorspelbare uitvoering, sterke governance en meetbare bedrijfsresultaten. In nauwe samenwerking met de Customer Lead, die verantwoordelijk is voor klantstrategie en waardecreatie, draag jij de verantwoordelijkheid voor delivery, planning, risicomanagement en operationele excellentie over teams, projecten en platforms heen.
 Je stimuleert schaalbare dienstverlening, ondersteunt strategische initiatieven zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE) en benut AI om programmamanagement en uitvoering verder te versterken.
 Succes wordt gemeten aan de hand van betrouwbare oplevering, effectief stakeholdermanagement, transparantie, risicobeheersing en continue verbetering binnen cloud- en AI-trajecten.
 Leid strategische cloud- en AI-programma’s en zorg voor succesvolle levering, sterke governance en aantoonbare bedrijfsresultaten.

 Vertaal klantdoelstellingen naar uitvoerbare plannen, roadmaps, budgetten en leveringsprioriteiten.

 Bouw en onderhoud vertrouwde relaties met klant stakeholders, waaronder senior management en directieleden.

 Stimuleer AI-gedreven delivery door Responsible AI, compliance, kwaliteit en operationele excellentie te integreren in de uitvoering.

 Werk nauw samen met Customer Leads om strategie, uitvoering en governance op elkaar af te stemmen.

 Signaleer groeikansen en stimuleer de adoptie van strategische proposities van CloudNation, zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

 Zorg voor heldere rapportages, effectief risicomanagement en continue verbetering binnen programma’s en teams.

 
 Gekoppeld aan het 6D Delivery Model 
 Discover 
Werk samen met Business Relationship Managers en klanten om doelstellingen, drijfveren en uitdagingen te begrijpen, inclusief de gebieden waar AI aantoonbare toegevoegde waarde kan creëren.
 Define 
Stel duidelijke programmadoelstellingen, scope, tijdlijnen en succescriteria vast, afgestemd op strategische prioriteiten en, voor AI-initiatieven, op data-volwassenheid en compliance-eisen.
 Design 
Begeleid teams bij het vormgeven van oplossingen met behulp van frameworks zoals Azure CAF & Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework, waarbij Responsible AI waar relevant wordt geïntegreerd.
 Develop 
Stuur op een hoogwaardige en flexibele uitvoering (Agile of Waterfall), inclusief beoordelingsmomenten en kwaliteitscontroles voor AI/ML-ontwikkeltrajecten.
 Deploy 
Leid de implementatie en overdracht van opgeleverde resultaten, waaronder CCoE-initiatieven en productiegereedheid (inclusief MLOps voor AI-oplossingen).
 Continuous Delivery 
Ondersteun klanten bij het operationaliseren van resultaten, draag samen met de Customer Lead verantwoordelijkheid voor governance en behoud het overzicht op continue verbetering en waardecreatie.
 
 
 
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het leiden van complexe cloudtrajecten, inclusief het aansturen van meerdere teams, budgetbeheer en stakeholdermanagement op senior niveau.

 Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van complexe programma’s met meerdere teams, waaronder de implementatie van proposities zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

 Sterke ervaring met delivery management in multicloudomgevingen (Azure en AWS), inclusief Azure CAF / Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

 Ervaring met AI- en/of dataprogramma’s, inclusief Responsible AI, compliance (zoals de EU AI Act) en de MLOps-levenscyclus.

 Werkt aantoonbaar AI-ondersteund, bijvoorbeeld met AI-agents zoals Claude of Claude Code, en stimuleert deze werkwijze binnen teams.

 Sterk in verwachtingenmanagement en in staat structuur en rust te brengen in complexe, veranderende omgevingen.

 Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden tot en met C-level, met sterke beheersing van risico’s, afhankelijkheden en budgetten.

 Kan de administratieve aspecten van programmamanagement zelfstandig beheren, waaronder projectinrichting, planning en facturatie.

jobs.title: Product Owner (Microsoft, Koddex, outils collaboratifs)
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.
 Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.
 Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.
 La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?
 Votre rôle 
 Au sein de la DSI d'Exotec, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille d'outils collaboratifs utilisés par nos Exopeople répartis en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.
 Votre mission consistera à définir la vision, piloter l'évolution et maximiser l'adoption des solutions collaboratives qui soutiennent les activités de l'entreprise. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot, etc.) ainsi que sur Koddex, plateforme stratégique pour le partage des connaissances et la gestion de nos processus internes.
 Véritable interface entre les métiers, les équipes IT et les partenaires externes, vous accompagnerez la transformation digitale d'Exotec en proposant des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée pour les utilisateurs.
 Vos missions 
 Définir et piloter la stratégie produit 
 Porter la vision des outils collaboratifs et définir une roadmap cohérente avec les priorités métiers, la stratégie IT et les ambitions de transformation digitale d’Exotec.
 Être responsable de la valeur produite par le portefeuille, en reliant chaque évolution à un résultat attendu pour les utilisateurs et l’entreprise.
 Arbitrer les priorités du portefeuille en tenant compte de l’impact utilisateur, de l’adoption attendue, des contraintes techniques, des risques et de la soutenabilité des solutions.
 Recueillir, challenger et prioriser les besoins 
 Être responsable de la discovery produit en recueillant des besoins de terrain auprès des utilisateurs, des métiers, de la DSI et des relais locaux en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.
 Challenger les demandes et distinguer les besoins structurants des préférences locales, en s’appuyant sur les données d’usage, les retours utilisateurs et l’impact business.
 Garantir que les décisions de priorisation et de roadmap reposent sur des éléments objectifs, des résultats mesurables et une compréhension réelle des usages.
 Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements 
 Piloter le cycle complet des évolutions, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise à disposition, en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, l’intégration et la valeur délivrée.
 Définir les critères de réussite et les standards de qualité des solutions, afin de sécuriser leur déploiement dans l’écosystème Exotec.
 Prendre les décisions de release et de cycle de vie en équilibrant valeur utilisateur, risques opérationnels, dépendances éditeurs et pérennité des plateformes.

 Garantir la cohérence, la rationalisation et l’évolution maîtrisée du portefeuille d’outils collaboratifs et de l’écosystème de connaissances.

 Expérience en Product Ownership, gestion de produit ou transformation digitale.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an  AI-first way of working . You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.

 Your Mission Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
 Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
 Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
 Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
 AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
 Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
 Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
 Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.
 

 Your Profile 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
 AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
 Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
 Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
 Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
 Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
 Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.
 
Nice to Have
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
 Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
 Early-stage startup background.
 Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
 Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.

 Fully paid vacation and sick leave.

Qui sommes-nous ? 
  
 Notre mission 
  
 Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. 
 ⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 
 👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !
 💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! 
  
 Le mot de la CEO 
 “Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon
  
 Et ce poste alors ? 
  
 Le rôle 
 Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).
 Ton objectif : générer un flux régulier de leads qualifiés pour l'équipe commerciale, à un coût d'acquisition maîtrisé, et faire de Solteo une référence de l'électrification des bâtiments auprès des installateurs. Tu accompagneras aussi le lancement de nos nouvelles offres.
  
 Missions et responsabilités 
 Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact.
 Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup , où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis.
 Discovery continue 

 Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact.
 Shaping & conception 

 Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe.
 Delivery & impact 

 Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer.
 Ownership & autonomie 

 Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet.
 
  
 Tes objectifs: 
 ⭐ Les 30 premiers jours — Comprendre 
 Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business.
 Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit.
 🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap. 
 ⭐ De 1 à 3 mois — Prendre en main ton périmètre 
 Tu prendras progressivement la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit. Tu mèneras tes propres investigations, participeras au shaping des sujets, concevras les solutions avec l'équipe et suivras leur livraison.
 🎯 Objectif : mener de manière autonome un sujet produit, de la compréhension du problème jusqu'à sa mise en production. 
 ⭐ De 3 à 12 mois — Devenir pleinement autonome 
 Tu pilotes ton périm

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico 
 Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
 We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is seeking a Lead AI Product Manager to pioneer our agent-first product strategy in Paris. You'll define and build the next generation of autonomous AI agents that transform how aerospace and manufacturing companies plan, optimize, and execute complex supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI in enterprise B2B, creating intelligent systems that make decisions, take actions, and deliver measurable business value autonomously . 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Own the product vision and execution for autonomous AI agents — define agent architectures, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform supply chain planning, inventory optimization, production scheduling, and MRO operations

 Lead complex cross-functional AI initiatives — drive discovery of high-value use cases, design agent personas and reasoning patterns, and pioneer agent-native UX paradigms including conversational interfaces and proactive recommendations

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, customer operations, sales, and enterprise customers to ensure AI features deliver measurable value and achieve adoption at scale

 Define the AI product vision and strategic roadmap with VP Product and engineering leadership, balancing innovation with enterprise deployment requirements around scalability, explainability, security, and compliance

 Drive excellence in AI product development — from experimentation frameworks to deployment best practices — championing data-driven decision making and rapid iteration to launch capabilities that deliver 10x productivity improvements to enterprise customers

 
 About You 
 5+ years in product management with 3+ years building AI/ML products, including hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, autonomous agents, or intelligent automation in Enterprise B2B SaaS

 Strong technical acumen across agent architectures — including multi-agent systems, LLM-based reasoning, tool use, RAG, RLHF, and safety mechanisms — to collaborate effectively with ML engineers and data scientists

 Proven track record shipping autonomous AI products to large enterprise customers, with experience navigating safety, compliance, auditability, and controlled autonomy requirements

 Outstanding communication skills in English and French — able to articulate complex agentic AI concepts to executives, engineers, and end users alike

 You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what’s possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

 Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

 Experience building agent-based products with frameworks like LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI, or custom agent architectures

 Background in operations research, supply chain, manufacturing, or aerospace industries

 
 Why Pelico 
 We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:
 Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

 Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

 Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

 Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

 Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

 A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.
 As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.
 What You’ll Do 
 · Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery
 · Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early
 · Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed
 · Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status
 · Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned
 · Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones
 · Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems
 · Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs
 Requirements 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline
 · 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered
 · Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential
 · Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage
 · Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing
 · Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme
 · Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current
 · Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic
 · Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

 Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â

 Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
 Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
 Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â

 The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
 Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â

jobs.title: People Product Lead
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
 We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
 Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
 In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
 But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
 Why this role exists 
 Multiverse builds AI products for the future of work, and we want our own People team to run on the same principles we sell to customers. This role is about building an AI-native People function from the ground up, with someone who thinks in systems: workflows, guardrails, tasks and constraints, rather than one-off fixes. We care more about how you learn and build than how many years you've clocked up. If you've built something you can show us, whether that's a tool, a process, or a system that scaled, bring it. That's a bigger part of the interview than a standard work history.
 
 What you'll actually do 
 A People Product Lead bridges People strategy with hands-on technical product management. You will build scalable foundations for internal operations such as core HR systems, automation, access, and data flows supporting ~1000 employees across the lifecycle
 Define the long-term vision, strategy, and quarterly roadmap for internal People Ops technology and platforms including success measures for the domain.

 Build scalable foundations across People systems that support the employee lifecycle, from core People platforms to integrations, data flows, identity and automation.

 Make high-quality trade-offs across build, buy and integrate decisions, balancing user experience, scalability, reliability, security and compliance.

 Lead through influence by aligning senior stakeholders across People, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Legal, Analytics and Operations.

 Improve productivity and reduce friction for Multiverse employees by simplifying processes and creating intuitive, reliable technology experiences.

 Drive measurable impact by defining KPIs, learning from delivery and continuously improving how the domain operates.
 

 You will be successful if… 
 You have 5+ years working in HR, in technology, analytics, or operations

 You think in systems: workflows, guardrails, constraints, and how the parts fit together

 You have a strong track record of learning fast and applying it

 You've built something real you can walk us through: a tool, a process, or a system you scaled
 

 This role won’t work for you if… 
 You're uncomfortable working with technology and automation

 You prefer high-touch, service-led processes over product-led ways of working

 
 

 Benefits 
 Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

 Health & Wellness - private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

 Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

 Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

 Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked! 

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
 We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here .
 Our Commitment to Safeguarding 
 Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy , our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).
