jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) | Festanstellung oder Freelance | München / Remote
jobs.description:
Standort: München, remote innerhalb Deutschlands
 Art: Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, jeweils mit Perspektive auf eine langfristige Partnerschaft
 Warum diese Rolle 
 Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion.
 Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status.
 Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026 
 Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert.
 Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen?
 Aufgaben
 Was du machst 
 Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

 Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können.

 Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

 Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie.

 Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen.

 Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos.

 Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise 
 Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie

 Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare

 KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung

 Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

 Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird.
 Anforderungen
 Was wir suchen 
 Must-haves 
 Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung.

 Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team.

 Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis: Du kennst moderne Web-Stacks, Datenbanken (Postgres) und APIs und weißt, wie Softwarearchitektur funktioniert.

 Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo.

 Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen.

 Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise.

 Nice-to-haves 
 Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung oder Informatik.

 Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams.

 Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects).

 Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs.
 Benefits
 So arbeiten wir 
 Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an.

 Flexibel: remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Standort München. Wichtig ist uns verlässliche Erreichbarkeit zu den üblichen Geschäftszeiten.

 Wenig Bürokratie: klare Verantwortlichkeiten, schnelles Feedback, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden.

 Was wir bieten 
 Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, je nachdem, was besser zu dir passt.

 Eine Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung entspricht, als Gehalt oder als Tages- bzw. Stundensatz.

 Die langfristige Perspektive, unseren Produktkern zu verantworten.

 Viel Eigenverantwortung und unmittelbare Wirkung auf ein echtes Produkt, das von aktiven Unternehmen genutzt wird.

 So bewirbst du dich 
 Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht über dich, deinen Hintergrund und deine Verfügba

jobs.description:

 The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension.
 With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector.
 Tasks
 As Proposal & Project Manager, you own proposal management for Infinite Orbits Germany's bids and funding applications and lead project delivery once contracts are won. You run the proposal process end to end, from planning and compliance through to final assembly and submission, while Business Development, the engineering team, and the R&D and Innovation Managers own the commercial, technical, and technology content. Alongside this, you support internal projects and financial calculations, contributing planning, costing, and delivery structure beyond customer-facing work.
 As a founding hire, you're not just executing proposals and projects: you're building the operating backbone that lets the German entity scale.
 Job Description 
 Proposal management ownership: Own the proposal process for RFI/RFP responses, customer proposals, and funding applications: proposal plan and deadlines, compliance matrix, work breakdown structure, schedule, cost model, and final assembly and submission. Coordinate content from Business Development, the engineering team, and the R&D and Innovation Managers.

 Project management: Own project planning, scheduling, budget tracking, and risk/issue management for won contracts, from kickoff through delivery.

 Internal project support: Contribute planning and delivery structure to internal projects; support financial calculations and cost modeling for proposals, internal projects, and business cases.

 PMO support across the Group: Support PMO activities and best-practice alignment across Infinite Orbits' sister companies, contributing to standardized project management tools, templates, and reporting processes.

 Subcontractor support: Manage the contractual, scheduling, and reporting relationship with subcontractors and external partners on German projects, working alongside the engineering team on technical oversight.

 Stakeholder reporting: Prepare project status reports and delivery updates for internal leadership and customer-facing stakeholders.

 Process build-out: Establish project management templates, tools, and reporting processes for the German entity as it scales.

 Requirements
 Education & Experience 
 Degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 3+ years of experience in project management, ideally including proposal writing.

 Experience with PMO processes or standardization across multiple business units or entities is a plus.

 Experience with projects or proposals for the Bundeswehr and its procurement organizations, DLR, or ESA is a plus.

 Skills & Other Requirements 
 Strong project management fundamentals: scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.

 Experience with financial and cost calculations supporting proposals and internal projects.

 Autonomy and ownership: able to build project management structure and processes from scratch.

 Fluent in German and English.

 Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

 Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations.

 Benefits
 A founding role with direct ownership of proposals, project delivery, and financial planning in a growing European space and defense company.

 Direct exposure to senior stakeholders across customer, partner, and Group-wide project environments.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 

Constructor Labs is the research arm of Constructor Knowledge, based at Campus Ring 1 in Bremen, Germany. Our work is organized around three units: Knowledge Labs, Cyber Labs and Science Labs. We apply computing, software and robotics research to make scientists, teachers and students more effective, working with institutional partners that include CERN, NUS, Carnegie Mellon and Fraunhofer. 

Constructor Practice is the hands-on practice platform within the Constructor Technology learning suite, alongside Learn, Assess, Proctor, Schedule and Groups. It spans an unusually broad portfolio: curriculum-aligned virtual science labs; the evidence-based intervention products Calcularis (numeracy and dyscalculia), Grafari/Orthograph (literacy and dyslexia); and browser-based Software & IT and Coding labs for technical training. Shared capabilities include cloud-based hands-on environments with no installation, automated assessment and grading, group assignments and instructor assistance, LMS integration, and learner analytics and dashboards. 

The product is in production across three distinct markets. Higher education and research, schools and public education authorities, and corporate and vocational training. The platform operates under GDPR, FERPA, COPPA and SOPIPA commitments. 

About the Role

You will own Constructor Practice content portfolio of products (currently includes Practice: Science Labs and Practice: Schools Math and Literacy with future extension to other disciplines) end to end: strategy, roadmap, commercial performance and delivery. This is a lead product management position with full accountability for the product line rather than for a single feature area or squad. 

The scope is wider than a conventional PM role. You will sit in front of clients during presales, shape the go-to-market with sales and marketing, define the roadmap across a portfolio serving three different buyer types, and work with product owners and engineering to bring releases in on time and on budget. Where the product line needs something that has no owner, it is yours. 

Practice has an established customer base and a portfolio that has grown through acquisition and expansion into markets with little in common: a Swiss canton buying dyscalculia intervention for primary schools has almost nothing in common with Acronis training its partner ecosystem. Bringing coherence to that portfolio, deciding what to invest in, what to standardize and what to retire, is the central problem of this role. 

Reporting and scope 

  • Reports to: Head of SI and Edu, Constructor Labs. 
  • Level: Lead Product Manager. You will lead the product team including product owners, engineers and subject matter experts, with a view to building a larger product team as the line grows.

  • Own the roadmap for the quantum software line and the decisions behind it.

WHO WE ARE

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

We are seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Product Owner with a passion for leveraging data to build impactful products. In this role, you will support the product development lifecycle for our data-driven marketing solutions, including the WPP Open platform. You'll be instrumental in translating user needs and data insights into clear product requirements, ensuring our solutions are innovative, valuable, and technically sound. At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Data to join our talented product team in our London office and lead the development of a portfolio of shared data products.

Our products and teams work with data spanning streaming, fan engagement, social and creator activity, and commerce. As new datasets and requirements emerge, we need to understand what the data contains, establish what it means and make it useful beyond the team or product where it originated.

You will own the strategy, roadmap and delivery of a portfolio of shared data products. Working with business stakeholders, source-product owners and data engineering, you will turn business needs into clear requirements, deliver dependable datasets and establish definitions and relationships that can be reused across products.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of shared data products, with a focus on developing new datasets to meet emerging business needs.   • Lead delivery and adoption. Maintain a prioritised backlog and work with engineering through implementation, validation, launch and ongoing improvement. Ensure the teams receiving the data can use it to meet the agreed need.

Develop the shared semantic layer through the initiatives you deliver, so concepts such as artists, tracks, markets, campaigns and audiences can be understood consistently across products.
  • Connect datasets to enable new capabilities. Identify where combining data creates value and lead the product work required, including opportunities to relate streaming performance to social activity, campaigns, fan engagement and commerce.
  • Make data discoverable and understandable. Ensure data products have clear documentation, usage examples and known limitations, helping analysts, data scientists and downstream product teams use them confidently.
  • Help develop and apply practical data standards. Partner with leadership, engineering and relevant specialists on quality, ownership, access, lineage and appropriate use. Translate these expectations into requirements for the data products you lead.
  • Agree responsibilities for ongoing use of the data products you deliver. Work with source-product owners and engineering teams to establish how source changes, maintenance, quality issues and communication with users will be handled for those initiatives.
  • Measure adoption and impact. Gather user feedback and evidence of usefulness, track whether the capabilities delivered meet their intended outcomes and use those findings to inform the roadmap.
  • Build stakeholder alignment. Explain priorities and investment decisions, communicate progress and translate technical considerations into clear business implications.

In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.
 
 The Role 
 As Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery, you will sit at the handoff point between ideas and engineering — taking a raw idea or ask and shaping it into a well-formed request the software team can build against. You own the what: defining the problem, scope, and acceptance criteria behind every request. Working alongside the Project Manager, who runs sprints and day-to-day delivery mechanics, you'll advocate for how requests should be sequenced and when they should land, making sure priority calls reflect the needs behind the work rather than just what's next in the queue.
 At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Turn ideas into formal requests: work with the Product Lead and other stakeholders to take a defined ask and translate it into a clear, engineering-ready ticket — problem statement, scope, acceptance criteria, and any relevant regulatory or clinical context — before it enters the backlog.

 Own and prioritise the software ticket pipeline in Jira: intake, triage, and grooming, so the backlog reflects real, current priority rather than the order things happened to arrive in.

 Own the idea-to-documentation handoff with the software team — making sure every piece of work that reaches engineering has the context, requirements, and supporting documentation it needs in Confluence, and that decisions made along the way are captured rather than lost in Slack.

 Advocate for how and when work should happen: partner with the Project Manager, who owns sprint planning and delivery mechanics, to make sure sequencing and timing reflect genuine priority rather than convenience.

 Keep the software pipeline's information in the right place — Jira for delivery, Confluence for documentation — rather than in slide decks or side channels, and help extend that operating model as the team grows.

 Skills & Experience: 
 Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, or Product Owner working directly with a software engineering team, ideally in a regulated or safety-conscious environment.

 Comfort writing requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for engineers to build against without repeated back-and-forth.

 A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

 Comfortable in an early-stage environment where requests arrive informally and priorities shift, and where part of the job is imposing structure rather than just following it.

 Drawn to the operational side of product management — energised by getting the machinery of idea-to-delivery running smoothly, not just by defining the vision.

 Nice to have: experience in medical devices or another regulated hardware/software environment, with exposure to documentation practices under ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role

As the Staff Product Manager, UK Market, you will define and execute Motive's product strategy for the UK, with the opportunity to expand your scope to continental Europe over time. You will own the commercial roadmap: where we compete, what we build, and in what order. You will then deliver it, working with engineering teams and peers across the product organization.

International expansion is one of the most important strategic initiatives at Motive. You will partner closely with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, product leaders, designers, and engineers to bring our products to customers who face different regulations, vehicles, hardware, and buying needs than in the US. You will be a senior voice in the room as leadership decides where to invest, and you will see those decisions through to shipped product.

To succeed, you must be comfortable influencing leaders across the company and navigating complex technical and organizational challenges. We operate like a startup within a larger organization, so you will wear many hats. Being entrepreneurial, commercially minded, and growth-oriented is critical.

What You'll Do

  • Define the UK product strategy. Decide which segments, products, and use cases to prioritise to win, grounded in customer, competitive, and regulatory insight.
  • Align the company on the right commercial roadmap. Work with GTM, finance, and executive leadership to turn market opportunity into prioritised roadmaps, business cases, and investment asks.
  • Execute with engineering. Partner with multiple engineering teams and product peers to scope, sequence, and deliver UK requirements, including regional feature adaptations, compliance products, and hardware and integration needs.
  • Build a deep understanding of UK customers, from fleet operators to drivers, through regular customer visits and field research, and translate what you learn into clear product requirements.
  • Influence across the product organization so that shared platform and product teams deliver against UK priorities.
  • Establish success metrics for the region, such as win rate, market coverage, adoption, and revenue, and report progress to senior leadership.
  • Contribute to the broader international strategy through market research, benchmarking, and financial and risk assessments.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in product management at a B2B company or on operational products, with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives at scale.
  • Strong product sense and execution, with the commercial judgement to tie roadmap decisions to business outcomes.
  • Deep analytical skills and the ability to synthesise insight for an executive audience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence up and across, including senior engineering and business leaders.
  • Experience in a startup or new team environment.
  • Based in the UK. London preferred for in-office collaboration. Ability to travel within the UK for customer visits and field research (about 1-2 times per quarter) and to San Francisco 1-2 times per year for team meetings.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with products similar to Motive's, such as connected devices, telematics, fleet or asset management, IoT hardware plus software, or AI video and safety products.
  • Experience with international launches or localization.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.
 
 You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track.  
 
 This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. 

 Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
 Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success  
 Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. 
 Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. 
 Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. 
 Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods. 
 

 Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. 
 Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. 
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills. 
 Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. 
 Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. 
 Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). 
 Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. 
 

 Preferred Qualifications Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
 IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. 
 Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. 
 Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. 
 Experience with Jira and Confluence. 
 Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation. 
 

 Why you'll love working here Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies
 Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries
 30 days paid vacation per year
 Salary bands for a fair corporate culture
 Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV
 Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path
 Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth
 Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis
 Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party
 Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year
 Free parking right outside the door
 Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass
 Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
 Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
 Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
 After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
 If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.

 What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
 You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
 We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
 Own the wealth product area end to end 
 Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
 Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
 Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
 Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
 Turn the data into something users act on 
 Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
 Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
 Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
 Own the numbers 
 Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
 Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
 Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you
 

 What we are looking for You might be a fit if: 
 You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
 You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
 You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
 You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
 Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
 You're fluent in English; German is a plus
 You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
 That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 
 Strong plus if you have: 
 PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
 Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
 Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
 Subscription and paywall experime

jobs.title: Project Manager Supply Chain (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen Für unsere Zentrale in Neumünster suchen wir zum schnellstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen 
 Project Manager Supply Chain (m/w/d)  
 auf 40-Stunden-Basis. 
 Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Themen zu strukturieren, unterschiedliche Beteiligte zusammenzubringen und Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung zu begleiten?  In dieser Position ergänzt du unseren Bereich Supply Chain und übernimmst die  eigenständige Koordination und Umsetzung definierter Projekte entlang unserer Lieferkette. 
Du sorgst dafür, dass Projektziele, Aufgaben, Verantwortlichkeiten und Timings klar definiert sind , behältst Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent verfolgt und umgesetzt werden. 
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Supply Chain-Team sowie internen Schnittstellen  wie Accounting, Controlling, Sales, IT und E-Commerce zusammen und koordinierst projektbezogen auch die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern sowie unseren Kollegen aus Europa und China. 
 Ziel der Rolle ist es, zusätzliche Projektkapazität innerhalb unserer Supply Chain zu schaffen, bereichsübergreifende Themen strukturiert voranzutreiben und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicherzustellen. 
 *Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit haben wir auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung männlicher, weiblicher und diverser Sprachformen verzichtet und das generische Maskulinum genutzt.
Sämtliche Personenbezeichnungen gelten gleichermaßen für alle Geschlechter. 

 Deine Aufgaben Eigenständige Verantwortung für definierte Projekte im Bereich Supply Chain – von der Konkretisierung der Projektziele und Planung über die Umsetzung bis zur Implementierung und zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss.
 Selbstständige Strukturierung übernommener Themen: Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über die Ausgangssituation, identifizierst Handlungsbedarfe und leitest daraus eigenständig die erforderlichen Arbeitsschritte, Verantwortlichkeiten und Timings ab.
 Eigenständige Beschaffung und Zusammenführung notwendiger Informationen aus den beteiligten Fachbereichen, Systemen sowie von internen und externen Ansprechpartnern
 Koordination und Steuerung der beteiligten internen und externen Ansprechpartner sowie aktive Herbeiführung notwendiger Abstimmungen, Zuarbeiten und Entscheidungen
 Aktive Steuerung des Projektfortschritts: Du behältst Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick, hältst diese konsequent nach und greifst bei Verzögerungen frühzeitig ein.
 Frühzeitige Identifikation von Risiken und Hindernissen sowie eigenständige Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungsansätze und Maßnahmen bzw. gezielte Einbindung der erforderlichen Entscheidungsträger
 Analyse bestehender Prozesse und Abläufe im Rahmen deiner Projekte  sowie Erarbeitung und Umsetzung konkreter Optimierungen gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen

jobs.title: Product Manager (English/French)
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally

About the role

This role sits on the front line: you engage directly with enterprise clients, lead discovery to uncover core business challenges, and design and ship tailored AI solutions built on Unframe's platform. You own the work end-to-end, serving as the strategic and technical bridge from initial conversation through to final deployment.

This is a true builder role. You write the precise specifications and prompt architectures that bring solutions to life, making the critical design decisions that determine whether an enterprise AI deployment actually succeeds.

What you’ll do

This is a project-led role with unmediated access to clients at every stage. You will typically manage several engagements simultaneously, with short planning horizons and evolving requirements. Roughly 30 to 40 percent of the role is active client management, ensuring senior stakeholders remain aligned through delivery, progress reviews, and post-deployment rollouts.

    • Lead Enterprise Discovery: Conduct discovery sessions directly with enterprise clients to map workflows, uncover business challenges, and distinguish surface-level requests from fundamental operational needs.
    • Design & Spec AI Solutions: Translate customer problems into structured solution plans on Unframe's platform. Write detailed specs and define prompt and context structures, owning the complete solution design.
    • Drive End-to-End Delivery: Collaborate with engineers and AI specialists to deliver solutions on target. Prioritize requirements and manage tradeoffs across speed, stability, and scope.
    • Represent the User & Platform: Act as the voice of enterprise operators and domain experts while collaborating with the Platform team to identify reusable product patterns.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles, with a proven track record working alongside engineering teams on complex, fast-paced technical products.
  • Bilingual Fluency (English & French): Fluent in French to connect with users and stakeholders in France, and fluent in English for daily collaboration across our international teams.
  • Customer-Led Discovery: Proven experience personally leading consultative conversations with enterprise buyers and operators - not supporting a sales call, not interviewing platform users, but owning the conversation to surface unstated needs and translate them into clear solution scope.
  • Enterprise Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage senior client relationships through a complex delivery; keeping stakeholders aligned, navigating competing priorities, and being the primary point of contact when requirements shift or timelines compress.
  • Problem-to-Solution Design: Ability to start from a raw business problem without existing features for reference, defining exactly how an AI solution should function and writing precise specs for build teams.
  • Complex Delivery Execution: Experience shipping AI-powered features under tight timelines, managing evolving requirements, and documenting strategic tradeoffs.
  • AI Solutions Experience: Direct exposure to building with LLMs - writing prompt structures, defining context and output constraints, working with agentic systems, or managing model uncertainty in a shipped product or working prototype. This is the dimension most learnable on the job; concrete work product carries more weight than certification.
  • Builder Orientation: Driven by creating customer-facing solutions rather than simply managing traditional roadmaps or processing requests.
  • Core Competencies: Strong written communication, systems thinking, high attention to detail, fluent English (written and verbal), and the ability to navigate multi-faceted projects.

Location

Remote (France): This position is 100%

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us: 
 Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
 Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.
 Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
 At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. 

About the role: 
 We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.
 This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.
 We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . 
 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

 Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

 Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

 Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

 Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

 Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

 Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

 Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

 Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

 Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

 Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

 
 You're a great fit if you: 
 Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

 Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

 Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

 Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

 Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

 Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

 Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways —

jobs.title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)
jobs.description:
About us 
 Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.
 As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.
 About the role 
 Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.
 As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.
 Responsibilities 
 Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

 Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

 Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

 Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

 Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

 Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

 Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

 Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

 Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

 Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

 About you 
 6+ years in product management

 Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

 AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

 Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

 Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

 Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

 Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

 Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

 You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

 Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

 A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

 Nice to have 
 Document or file-processing products

 A utility business with a strong free tier

 Experience with high-volume consumer tools

 Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

 Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate. 
 
 Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact! 
 Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.
 Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values .
 
 Our Benefits 
 🌍 You get to impact

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
 You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.
 
 What you'll do
 Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

 Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

 Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

 Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

 Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

 Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

 Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Project Manager / Consultant (German required)
jobs.description:
Location: Hybrid, Zürich (2-3 days in office) 
 
 About what. AG 
 We're a Zurich-based digital consultancy with 40+ ambitious, kind specialists. We build websites, digital products and growth strategies powered by data and AI, for clients from innovative startups to global brands. Learn more at what.digital . 

 The role: You take a business-first, data-driven view of what's holding a client's growth back, use AI to diagnose it faster and deeper than a traditional audit, and turn it into a concrete plan that works. It's a long-term role with variety, autonomy, support and a clear path to grow. 

 How we work: You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class help to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we think like entrepreneurs: when we build for clients, everyone wins - our clients, what. and you. 

 
 What you'll do: 
 Be the main point of contact for your clients and build long-term relationships - you think about their business, not just their campaigns. 

 Implement growth strategies across SEO/GEO, paid ads, email, social and more, using AI with the team. 

 Coordinate specialists to deliver great work on time and on budget, with high standards and honest feedback. 

 Run data and AI-assisted analyses to find growth opportunities and turn them into business cases and new projects. 

 Keep an eye on budgets and billing, with support from our finance team. 

 Optional: lead the specialist team, including team happiness and recruiting. 

 
 Key & Essential Skills: 
 Ideally 7+ years in a performance agency (not media buying), including 3+ years leading a team of 3+. 

 Deep knowledge of at least 3 marketing channels (e.g. SEO, Google Ads, Meta, content), with CHF 1M+ in total managed budget. 

 Proven record in client strategy, sales and building data-driven business cases that clients invest in. 

 Native-level German, understanding of Swiss German, fluent English. 

 Comfortable using AI as a core tool for analysis, reporting and consulting. 

 
 What makes you a fit: 
 You like taking ownership and seeing things through. 

 You give honest feedback, to clients and to us. 

 You know when to plan carefully, when to perfect, and when to move fast. 

 You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward. 

 
 Perks: 
 Beautiful office in Seefeld, Zurich. 

 You'll have real responsibility and influence - and a team that has your back. If you see something that could be improved, speak up - we're listening. 

 Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy - we're results-oriented and don't micromanage. 

 A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude. 

 25 days holiday plus public holidays. 

 Fair compensation and profit participation. 

 Personal development opportunities, e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins' UPW event. 

 
 How to Apply: 
 Apply via our website with your CV and a 2-3 min intro video in German (e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what attracted you to this role and share an example where you helped a client grow or improved something at work. 

 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won't be considered.

jobs.title: Copy of Product Manager, New Content Initiatives and Analysis
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating or licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured content into the AlphaSense platform. The team reports to the Chief Content Officer and has strategy, product and content management, collection operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing rapid growth across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust, and accountability in our relationships within the Content teams and with external partners and internal stakeholders.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a Product Manager for New Content Evaluation and Analysis to help us expand and strengthen the breadth, quality, and value of the data and content that power our Platform. Candidates should have deep knowledge of capital markets and investment research combined with extensive experience of evaluating and integrating financial research content and AI-powered investment analysis workflows.

Major Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Identify the Need and Showcase the Value:  Help identify and evaluate third-party quantitative and qualitative datasets and content for the needs of the AlphaSense platform (e.g. market data, fundamentals, estimates, ESG, news, research, transcripts, regulatory filings, and alternative data). Work alongside Partnership Management and Content Leads to assess data quality, methodology, licensing terms, and integration feasibility.
  • Lead the Due Diligence Effort: Run point on active vendor evaluations, including data trials, support proofs of concept, and own the framework to evaluate coverage, timeliness, accuracy, and history analysis. Help build content org-wide business case for new datasets and quantify value proposition, cost, buy vs build impact, and strategic fit
  • Become a Use Case Expert for AlphaSense content. Contribute to market research and competitive analysis to identify net new opportunities for innovation and differentiation. Identify new high impact AI-driven functionality and data sets and formulate the licensing target vendor or self-sourcing strategy to introduce new content into the AlphaSense platform and agentic workflows.
  • Market Research and Assessment: Track industry trends and competing platforms, solutions, and content to deliver competitive intelligence and better evolve product and content vision. Keep abreast of a rapidly evolving competitive landscape and client expectations along with unprecedented LLM and AI workflow advances. 

Who You Are:

  • You have genuine excitement and passion for corporate finance, capital markets, and investment research coupled with data management expertise demonstrated either in previous capacity at a buy-side or sell-side firm or you have successfully supported AI products/features/data used by investment and data analysis professionals
  • You have natural enthusiasm for working at the intersection of AI, data, technology, and investment research and track record of expert-level data analysis at scale using traditional data query or generative AI tools and platforms
  • You have the energy and enthusiasm to work in a high-paced, high-growth environment and you are comfortable accommodating rapidly changing business priorities
  • You have excellent presentation skills with demonstrated ability to inform and influence executives and align with multiple levels of stakeholders
  • You have driven successful due dilig

jobs.title: Product Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!

In a nutshell 

As a Product Manager at Picnic, you’ll be at the forefront of innovation, tackling complex challenges with fresh, groundbreaking solutions. This role is all about driving impact - you’ll develop product strategies by analyzing data and identifying opportunities that push boundaries and define the way we’re building our supply chain logic.

Tricks of the trade

  • Setting new standards: implementing the next generation of purchasing algorithms, last mile logic, warehouse components or onboarding automation
  • Improving the fully automated warehouse: going beyond the business case by designing better strategies and building robust systems (e.g. designing new picking strategies, improving the automated storage system)
  • Innovating across borders: building a new fully automated warehouse in Germany, opening a new warehouse in France or working on a streamlined supply chain across borders? You will deliver impact all over Europe.
  • Building sustainable solutions: launch new initiatives to improve the quality of fresh products like fruits, vegetables and bread during storage and delivery to improve customer satisfaction, and enable us to operate a supply chain where we consider safety first 
  • Leading with ambition: Using your relentless determination and grit to take the driver's seat and redefine the puzzle behind a smooth grocery shopping experience

Your superpowers

  • Master’s degree in Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics, Physics or an equivalent quantitative study
  • 2-5 years of work experience in a product-led company, ideally experienced with building supply chain solutions
  • Problem-solving mindset and passion for tackling complex challenges
  • Strong communication skills which allow you to convert abstract plans into concrete actions for your team

*Please Note: This is not a one-time hire. We’re hiring for this role throughout the year as part of our ongoing growth and expansion. 

Picnic Perks 

🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

🚲Health insurance discount & bike plan

We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application. 

🍎Learning & development 

You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy trainings, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses. 

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well.

jobs.title: Graduate Product Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Always wanted to build the systems behind one of Europe's most advanced supply chains? As part of this Graduate Program, you'll own part of Picnic's supply chain tech products from day one. You'll be end-to-end responsible for developing products that power our operations by understanding operational challenges, analyzing data, working with business teams, designing solutions with engineers, and validating impact through experiments and analytics. You're the one making it happen. The program at Picnic is one of the most ambitious tracks in the industry: from recent graduate to Product Manager.

Wondering what problems you’ll work on? Think optimising how items are picked in our automated fulfilment center, decreasing waste by optimal ordering, designing a flow how we make sure coolpacks for chilled deliveries get back to the fulfilment center or integrating with robots to automate our operations even more.

What you'll be doing

Over 18 months you'll learn everything it takes to build a great product by actually doing it. You'll work alongside experienced product managers in our team. You will spend your program embedded deeply in one supply chain domain to see the long-term impact of your products, with options to expand scope into adjacent domains as you scale after 18 months. Every 3 months, you will reflect on your growth and define new learning goals with your mentor to grow you into the Product Manager role as fast as possible. 

  • 0-6 months

You learn how to solve operational and internal user problems. From day one, you’ll help build features used by thousands of users, while getting to know our product end to end. To understand what to build, you’ll analyze operational processes through data analysis and interviews. Based on your learnings you’ll help shape new features.

  • 6-12 months

You build your first features from scratch. This is the first time you'll own the full product development lifecycle. With the help of an experienced Product Manager, you’ll scope a supply chain problem, shape the solution across design, engineering, data, and business. You’ll drive execution on your plan, ship to customers & see the direct impact of your work.

  • 12+ months

You own a product scope end to end. You decide what problems to solve and own the solutions: the research, the analyses, the designs, the stakeholders, the tech. You are in the lead and responsible for the outcome.

The Program

  • The launchpad to Product Manager. Learn everything there is about building product & become a PM twice as fast as the industry standard.
  • Ownership from day one. You’ll immediately work on improving our Supply Chain, alongside our experienced product teams. You’ll get to experience different scopes ranging from warehouse operations to ordering inbound and from optimal planning of deliveries and routing to our in-house built apps used by thousands of our operational colleagues. 
  • Tangible impact: Every feature you ship is measured, so you'll see the exact impact of your decisions in real data. If it works, double down. If it doesn't, own it and iterate.
  • Mentorship: You'll have a dedicated mentor accelerating your growth. Your mentor will grow you as a Product Manager, and also be your guide into the domain. But most of what you learn, you learn by actually doing it.

Who are you

We’re looking for future leaders who are hungry to learn, eager to build, and passionate about our mission. You don’t need years of product management experience, but you do need to show us you have the raw talent and drive to succeed.

  • Master's degree in a quantitative field like Econometrics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. Recent graduate or up to two years of professional experience.
  • Builder at heart. You've taken initiative and created something from scratch, whether that's a side project, a new idea, or your own startup.
  • Highly ambitious, natural curiosity and empathy for users. You want to understand, you're always asking "why", and you always think about how to make things better.
  • Go-getter personality. You're biased toward action and constantly pushing toward clarity and delivery.

 About us 
 

 Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.

Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.

We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself . We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves . 
 

 From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM. 
 

 Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading. 
 

 

 
 This role calls for a strong hunter mindset and passion for working in a hyper-growth MarTech scale-up with a rapid sales cycle. Good news: our differentiated product is already in high demand! jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer - Audiobooks
jobs.description:
We're looking for a strategic, detail-oriented Senior Product Manager to join the Books Vertical and lead end-to-end book experiences on Spotify: from discovery and conversion through to listening, and from the creator pipeline through to the consumer shelf. This role is about connecting the dots across our core experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling to make books work seamlessly on Spotify.

 Books are a major focus for Spotify, and we need someone who can look holistically across the book ecosystem to identify gaps, reduce friction, and make sure our experiences are coherent end-to-end. You'll focus on making the full books journey work better for listeners, creators, and rights-holders, not just shipping new features. You'll partner closely with Personalization, Subscriptions, Experience, and creator-facing teams to strengthen and evolve book experiences across surfaces, and help shape a product strategy that directly improves how listeners discover and enjoy books.

 What You'll Do 
 

 
 Shape and execute product strategy across core book experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling.

 
 Partner with teams across Spotify to identify and close gaps across book surfaces, creating a coherent end-to-end experience from content pipeline through to the consumer experience.

 
 Collaborate with Design, Engineering, Product Insights, and Program Management to lead improvements across discovery, conversion, listening, and creator-facing surfaces.

 
 Conduct, commission, and use research to understand listener behavior, creator needs, book consumption patterns, and market trends.

 
 Use qualitative and quantitative insights to identify the most impactful opportunities across the book ecosystem and prioritize accordingly.

 
 Define and track success metrics across the book experience, connecting upstream pipeline health with downstream listener outcomes.

 
 Identify systemic friction points and opportunities across the book ecosystem, and advocate for improvements that strengthen the end-to-end experience.

 Who You Are 
 

 
 You have 4+ years of experience in product management, ideally working across complex product ecosystems with multiple surfaces, partners, and dependencies.

 
 You have a track record of improving multi-surface product experiences, not just launching new features but making existing systems work better together.

 
 You use analytics, A/B testing, and user research to guide product decisions.

 
 You're comfortable working across both consumer-facing and platform or tooling surfaces, and can move between listener needs and creator needs.

 
 You communicate clearly and build shared understanding across teams that don't always see each other's work, translating between consumer, pipeline, and creator perspectives.

 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity and managing complexity across multiple teams and partners.

 
 You think in systems and map how changes in one part of the ecosystem (content pipeline, creator tooling, conversion flows, consumer surfaces) affect the rest.

 
 You look for the most impactful fix rather than optimizing surfaces in isolation.

 Where You'll Be 
 
 

 This role is based in London or Stockholm

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. 

 

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
